import torch
from clharness.train.hooks import BaseHook

class SelectiveLexicalUpdates(BaseHook):
    def on_run_start(self, ctx):
        self.weight = ctx.model.get_input_embeddings().weight
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.previous = self.weight.detach().clone()
        self.active = torch.zeros(self.weight.shape[0], dtype=torch.bool, device=self.weight.device)

    def select_batch(self, ctx, batch):
        self.active.zero_()
        tokens = batch.reshape(-1).to(device=self.weight.device)
        self.active[tokens] = True
        return batch

    def on_step_end(self, ctx, stats):
        with torch.no_grad():
            for start in range(0, self.weight.shape[0], 4096):
                end = min(start + 4096, self.weight.shape[0])
                fraction = torch.where(self.active[start:end], 1.0, 0.25)
                fraction = fraction.to(dtype=self.weight.dtype).unsqueeze(1)
                updated = torch.lerp(self.previous[start:end], self.weight[start:end], fraction)
                self.weight[start:end].copy_(updated)
            self.previous.copy_(self.weight)

import torch
from clharness.train.hooks import BaseHook

class FilterOptimizerIncrements(BaseHook):
    def on_run_start(self, ctx):
        self.weights = [p for p in ctx.model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
        self.previous = [p.detach().clone() for p in self.weights]
        self.filtered = [torch.zeros_like(p, dtype=torch.float32) for p in self.weights]
        self.steps = 0
        self.beta = 0.8

    def on_domain_start(self, ctx, domain):
        self.steps = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for p, previous, filtered in zip(self.weights, self.previous, self.filtered):
                previous.copy_(p)
                filtered.zero_()

    def on_step_end(self, ctx, stats):
        self.steps += 1
        correction = 1.0 - self.beta ** self.steps
        with torch.no_grad():
            for p, previous, filtered in zip(self.weights, self.previous, self.filtered):
                increment = p.float() - previous.float()
                filtered.mul_(self.beta).add_(increment, alpha=1.0 - self.beta)
                p.copy_(previous.float() + filtered / correction)
                previous.copy_(p)
params.title: Bias-corrected temporal filtering of optimizer increments
